final: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM patient_ratios), first_group AS (SELECT p.ratio FROM patient_ratios AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS second_avg FROM first_group) SELECT AVG(f.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(f.ratio - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.ratio - s.second_avg) AS avg_above_second FROM first_group AS f CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE f.ratio > s.second_avg
